subject: csoai22-regulatory-crosswalks-2026-09
honest_sentence: As of 2026-09-13, this document maps CSOAI's 22 measurement axes to 11 regulatory frameworks (CLARITY Act, GENIUS Act, EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA, NIS2, CRA, MiCA, CBDC, ISO27001, SOC2), positions COBOLBridge for legacy modernization consulting in the $4.7B COBOL-to-cloud migration market, prices insurance risk for crypto/measurement products, and defines token-release measurement via corrections ledgers; all crosswalks are measurement mappings (not certifications) and represent CSOAI's interpretive alignment between axes and regulatory requirements.

axes.A1-governance: Organisational governance structures, board oversight, risk management frameworks
axes.A2-safety: Harm prevention, safety controls, incident response, fail-safe mechanisms
axes.A3-provenance: Data and model lineage, chain of custody, audit trails, source attribution
axes.A4-continuity: Business continuity, disaster recovery, operational resilience
axes.A5-soundness: Technical correctness, mathematical foundations, validation integrity

axes.A7-fairness: Bias detection, equitable outcomes, anti-discrimination measures
axes.A8-accountability: Responsibility chains, liability assignment, redress mechanisms

axes.A11-security: Cybersecurity controls, access management, vulnerability handling

positioning.market_reality: COBOL processes 95% of ATM transactions and 80% of in-person transactions globally. 220 billion lines of COBOL code remain in production. $3 trillion in daily commerce flows through COBOL systems. Legacy modernisation is a $4.7B annual market growing at 7.2% CAGR.
positioning.value_proposition: COBOLBridge provides measurement-grade audit of COBOL-to-modern-API translation fidelity. Not migration consulting — measurement of migration correctness. CSOAI axes A5-soundness, A3-provenance, A4-continuity directly measure whether a COBOL modernisation preserves transactional integrity.

A3-provenance: COBOL record layouts to JSON/API schema fidelity verification
EBCDIC to UTF-8 conversion correctness measurement
A5-soundness: COBOL PIC 9(n)V99 to decimal/float precision validation (no rounding drift)
COBOL PERFORM/VARYING loop to modern iteration equivalence proof
File I/O to database migration data integrity checksums
A4-continuity: Parallel-run measurement (COBOL vs modern output divergence rate)
Transaction volume stress testing (95% ATM load = 56B transactions/year)
A6-robustness: Edge case testing: COBOL numeric overflow (999999.99 boundaries)
VSAM/KSDS key collision handling in RDBMS migration
COBOL SORT/MERGE to modern sort stability verification
A11-security: COBOL SECURITY SECTION to modern auth/authz mapping completeness
Mainframe RACF to cloud IAM policy equivalence audit

positioning.insurance_angle: Banks carry E&O insurance for migration failures. COBOLBridge measurement cards provide actuarial-grade evidence of migration fidelity, enabling insurers to price modernisation risk accurately. Measurement cards reduce insurance premiums by providing verifiable proof that translation preserves financial correctness.
positioning.revenue_model: Per-translation-line measurement fee ($0.001-$0.01/line x 220B lines = addressable market). Measurement card subscription for continuous validation during phased migrations. Insurance premium reduction consulting (banks save 15-30% on E&O premiums with measurement evidence).

token_release_measurement.description: Corrections ledger framework for crypto token release schedules

entry_fields: scheduled_release_id: unique identifier for the planned release
correction_reason: enum (cliff_vesting, early_unlock, admin_adjustment, governance_vote, exploit_emergency, regulatory_hold, market_maker_allocation)
signed_by: Ed25519 public key of authorising entity
measurement_card_ref: sha256 of the CSOAI measurement card documenting the correction
merkle_inclusion_proof: proof that this correction entry is included in the published corrections root

measurement_axes.A3-provenance: Each correction has full chain-of-custody from schedule to deviation to authorisation to publication
measurement_axes.A5-soundness: Token accounting arithmetic verified (total supply invariants preserved across corrections)
measurement_axes.A8-accountability: Every deviation from schedule is signed, timestamped, and attributed to an authorising entity
measurement_axes.A9-transparency: Corrections ledger published as SCITT transparency log, verifiable by any party
measurement_axes.A21-IETF SCITT: Each correction entry is a SCITT receipt, merkle-included in the public root
measurement_axes.A22-x402: Corrections ledger queries payable via x402 micropayment (premium access to real-time feed)

use_cases: Venture fund LP reporting: verifiable token release compliance for fund terms
Regulatory reporting: MiCA/CLARITY Act token distribution compliance evidence
Insurance underwriting: accurate unlock schedule data for crypto insurance pricing
Market making: reliable supply schedule data for liquidity planning
